## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ConfigureEnterpriseLogin`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `configure-enterprise-login`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ConfigureEnterpriseLogin**.

## Step 2: Configure Asgardeo

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to [Asgardeo](https://asgardeo.io/). -->
2. <!-- manual: [Configure your IdP as an external IdP in Asgardeo](https://wso2.com/asgardeo/docs/guides/authentication/enterprise-login/). You can select OpenID Connect or SAML as the protocol between Asgardeo and your IdP. :::note If you use OpenID Connect, configure the requested scopes so that Asgardeo can retrieve the relevant group or role details from the external IdP. ::: -->
3. <!-- manual: Configure the application: 1. In the Asgardeo Console left navigation menu, click Applications. You will see an application named WSO2_LOGIN_FOR_DEVANT_CONSOLE. 2. Click on the application to edit it. 3. Click the Sign-in Method tab. 4. Configure the IdP for login based on the protocol you selected: -->
4. <!-- manual: For OpenID Connect, follow the instructions in [Enable the OIDC IdP for login](https://wso2.com/asgardeo/docs/guides/authentication/enterprise-login/add-oidc-idp-login/#enable-the-oidc-idp-for-login). -->
5. <!-- manual: For SAML, follow the instructions in [Enable the SAML IdP for login](https://wso2.com/asgardeo/docs/guides/authentication/enterprise-login/add-saml-idp-login/#enable-the-saml-idp-for-login). -->
6. Select **Groups** attribute. 4. Click **Save** and.
7. Select **Save Changes**.
8. <!-- manual: Add the user attributes as OpenID Connect scopes: 1 -->

## Step 3: Map groups to enterprise IdP groups

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev/). -->
2. In the top navigation menu, select **Organization**. This opens the organization's home page.
3. In the left navigation menu under **Admin**, select **Settings**. This opens the organization-level settings page.
4. Select **Access Control** tab and.
5. Select **Groups**.
6. Select **Manage IdP Group Mapping**.
7. <!-- manual: Click the edit icon for the group you want to map to an enterprise IdP group. -->
8. <!-- manual: In the IdP Group Name field, enter the exact name you configured in the enterprise IdP and press Enter to add it. :::tip Changes to IdP group mappings take effect from the next login session onwards. ::: -->
9. Select **Save**.
